text: 54-year-old male. The patient has been experiencing a gradual difficulty in walking over the past 3 months, requiring wheelchair assistance for the last month. speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)

I have noted your age, the progression of your gait issues over three months leading to wheelchair dependence, the one-year history of urinary incontinence, and the recent onset of speech slurring. Given the combination of upper and lower motor neuron signs (inferred from the progressive nature and speech/walking issues) without significant sensory loss, do you have any family history of similar neurological conditions or a history of muscle weakness in your arms or legs?
